answer: Run sting offers. Auditors pose as clone farmers and quietly offer agents bribes to vouch for fake identities. Honest agents report the offer and earn a reward; any agent that accepts loses its stake and its vouchees are frozen. Like a comet, each offer is rare and unpredictable, so a farmer can never tell a real accomplice from a trap. Climbing the reputation terrace needs vouchers, and each corrupted voucher risks a 500-token jade-locked bond, so recruiting 100 accomplices puts 50,000 tokens at risk.
